description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'CaffeineTbTransactionalCache' implementing transactional cache logic using Caffeine cache, supporting operations like get, put, evict, and transaction management with locking and transaction tracking.

classes.name: CaffeineTbTransactionalCache
classes.description: An abstract class implementing transactional cache operations with locking, transaction management, and cache interaction.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value wrapper for the given key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Puts a value into the cache for the specified key, failing all related transactions.

methods.name: putIfAbsent
methods.description: Puts a value if absent, failing all related transactions.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes a key from cache, failing all related transactions.

methods.name: evict(Collection<K>)
methods.description: Removes multiple keys from cache, failing all related transactions.

methods.name: evictOrPut
methods.description: Evicts a key; no direct put due to cache semantics.

methods.name: newTransactionForKey
methods.description: Creates a new transaction for a single key.

methods.name: newTransactionForKeys
methods.description: Creates a new transaction for multiple keys.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits a transaction, applying pending puts if successful, and marking other transactions as failed.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back a transaction by removing it.
